title: 我的家 — My Family
summary: A short introduction about a family living in Taipei.

paragraphs.hanzi: 我家有三個人：爸爸、媽媽和我。
paragraphs.pinyin: wǒ jiā yǒu sān ge rén: bàba, māma hé wǒ.
paragraphs.translation: My family has three people: dad, mom, and me.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄧㄡˇ ㄙㄢ ㄍㄜˋ ㄖㄣˊ： ㄅㄚˋ ㄅㄚˋ、 ㄇㄚ ㄇㄚ ㄏㄜˊ ㄨㄛˇ。
paragraphs.text: 我家有三個人：爸爸、媽媽和我。
paragraphs.romanization: wǒ jiā yǒu sān ge rén: bàba, māma hé wǒ.
paragraphs.translation_en: My family has three people: dad, mom, and me.
paragraphs.translation_id: Keluarga saya ada tiga orang: ayah, ibu, dan saya.

paragraphs.hanzi: 爸爸是工程師，媽媽是老師。
paragraphs.pinyin: bàba shì gōngchéngshī, māma shì lǎoshī.
paragraphs.translation: Dad is an engineer, mom is a teacher.

paragraphs.text: 爸爸是工程師，媽媽是老師。
paragraphs.romanization: bàba shì gōngchéngshī, māma shì lǎoshī.
paragraphs.translation_en: Dad is an engineer, mom is a teacher.
paragraphs.translation_id: Ayah seorang insinyur, ibu seorang guru.

paragraphs.hanzi: 我們住在台北，台北是一個很漂亮的城市。
paragraphs.pinyin: wǒmen zhù zài táiběi, táiběi shì yí ge hěn piàoliang de chéngshì.
paragraphs.translation: We live in Taipei; Taipei is a very beautiful city.

paragraphs.text: 我們住在台北，台北是一個很漂亮的城市。
paragraphs.romanization: wǒmen zhù zài táiběi, táiběi shì yí ge hěn piàoliang de chéngshì.
paragraphs.translation_en: We live in Taipei; Taipei is a very beautiful city.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kami tinggal di Taipei; Taipei adalah kota yang sangat indah.
